description: Bambuddy Uses Hardcoded Secret Key + Many API Endpoints do not Require Authentication
how_introduced: Yes. AI-authored commit a7319f0e7087cee59f1aa658c52c6408f1fb71e8 added the unauthenticated `debug_simulate_print_complete` printer route that `a82f9278d2d587b7042a0858aab79fd8b6e3add9` later secured. When `f8857ba66643eb3ce97116dd90c0e75a9474f924` introduced optional authentication without a default-deny layer for existing API routes, that AI-authored endpoint became one of the exposed endpoints covered by the CVE; I found no evidence AI authored the hardcoded JWT secret.

bug_commits.author: maziggy
bug_commits.message: Fix browser freeze on print completion with camera stream open

agent_verdicts.reasoning: `a82f9278d2d587b7042a0858aab79fd8b6e3add9` adds `_=RequirePermissionIfAuthEnabled(Permission.PRINTERS_CONTROL)` to `debug_simulate_print_complete`, and blame on the vulnerable pre-fix file attributes that route definition and signature (lines 1402-1418 in `backend/app/api/routes/printers.py`) to `a7319f0e7087...`. The commit diff for `a7319...` shows it introduced the debug endpoint with only `db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)` and no auth/permission dependency. The screening hypothesis is directionally right, but this commit predates the auth feature; it authored one of the exact later-fixed unauthenticated endpoints, while `f8857...` later made that omission exploitable when auth was enabled.
